devices.note: Per-device status matrix for mainline ports, newest evidence wins. Each row: title = subsystem; general = status (works / partial / not yet / not started) and what that means; instance = the evidence and its versions; date = the latest evidence. F(x)tec Pro1-X (qx1050, SM6115 / Snapdragon 662) as of 2026-10-28: own kernel 7.3.0-qx1050 (v7.3 plus 22 device commits), SailfishOS 5.2.0.22 (upgraded in place from 5.1.0.11 on 2026-10-27), oFono 2.12.0+git4 with patches 0019 and 0020, PulseAudio 17.0+git2, Mesa 25.1.8, libcamera 0.7.2-4 with AF patches; reference OS NixOS (nyymi609/fxtec-pro1x-nixos, Linux 7.1) on the same unit. 'works' means confirmed by use on the device, not by a multi-day reliability test; no suspend or long-uptime measurements exist yet.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Upstream kernel support for the board
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: partial: SoC and board DTS upstream; keyboard, audio, camera, Bluetooth, battery and vibration are carried as out-of-tree patches.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Upstream sm6115-fxtec-pro1x.dts by Dang Huynh: base v6.5, display/GPU/touch/Wi-Fi/USB/Type-C/SD/modem nodes v6.12, latest change 2026-05-19. postmarketOS (renamed Nura on 2026-09-27) has device-fxtec-qx1050 in testing on kernel 6.10. The port's series is triaged in upstreaming.json.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: SailfishOS/devices.json fxtec_mainline_2026.pro1x_qx1050, nura_rename; Pro1-X port repo port/kernel/HANDOVER.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Boot
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: own kernel and initramfs next to NixOS (one-shot entry); user session at 14 s, lipstick ready at ~22 s; still booted through NixOS's U-Boot and boot partition
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: SailfishOS 5.2.0.22, kernel 7.3 + 22 patches; session no longer waits for the modem (ofono started by qx1050-modem-prep) or Wi-Fi; libssc no longer blocks sensorfwd. Modem watchdog crash on about every second boot (notes/modem-dog-crash.md).

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Display and backlight
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: panel, brightness with a proper dark minimum, clean fade at blank (display off from .disable, patch 0023), double-tap to wake.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: BOE BF060Y8M-AJ0 at 60 Hz (pixel clock patch); blank flash fixed 2026-10-29; harmless 'Failed to write display brightness: -22' once in hours on 7.3.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: port log 2026-10-26 20:40; Pro1-X port repo port/notes/upstream.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: GPU
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: Adreno 610 on freedreno; memory-bandwidth votes added (patch 0021)
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Mesa 25.1.8: Benchymark +25 % Benchy large, +37 % Overdraw, +8 % Shader light with the GFX3D->EBI vote; devfreq 320-950 MHz reaches 950 under load; UBWC 1.0 configured.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: port log 2026-10-23, 2026-10-27; Pro1-X port repo port/notes/sfos-5.2-upgrade.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Goodix (module, config blob from the firmware loader); double-tap-to-wake reliable on 7.1; probed on 7.3.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: all keys, slide open/close blanking, keyboard backlight; relies on SailfishOS-only DT changes (Fn as RIGHTALT, inverted slide switch).

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: A2DP, repeated off/on reconnects
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Moondrop Space Travel Ultra 2 earbuds, kernel 7.3 (the 7.1 re-power failure is gone).

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Modem registration and SIM
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: partial: registers on LTE at boot and the SIM is present in the stack; Settings shows it only on the Mobile network page, no 'SIM cards' page (single slot registered).
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: UIM provisioning activated every boot by qx1050-modem-prep; oFono slot driver patch 0019 exposes one slot.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Mobile data
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: IPv4 data over rmnet, Settings toggle switches it on and off.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: SailfishOS 5.2.0.22 with oFono patch 0020 (DPM open port, QMAPv4, bind without client-type): ping 3/3 about 40 ms, HTTPS 200 over rmnet_data2 on a clean boot.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: calls in both directions with audio both ways on the earpiece; volume keys set the call volume.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: oFono 2.12 signalling; q6voice VoiceMMode1 session from qx1050-voicecall 0.1-6, which restarts the stalling codec DMA back ends and maps the call volume onto the RX digital gain. Speaker and headset in calls, echo cancelling still open (2026-10-29).
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: Pro1-X port repo port/packages/qx1050-voicecall/README.md, commit 9f784e6; moWerk call tests 2026-10-29

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Rear camera
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: photos and video in jolla-camera with autofocus; viewfinder 10-20 fps on the GPU software ISP.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: IMX582 + DW9800 VCM, libcamera 0.7.2-4 (soft-ISP AF RFC plus own sharpness statistic and tuned scan), GPU debayer since SailfishOS 5.2 (cam 32 fps at 1280x960, 20 fps at 2000x1500); softened VCM ramps reduce the start click; 1984-wide 1080p mode.

related_devices.title: F(x)tec Pro1 (qx1000, MSM8998): mainline status
related_devices.general: not started (for a mainline SailfishOS port): upstream has the board DTS without display, panel, GPU or keyboard; those exist only in a stale fork.
related_devices.instance: Upstream msm8998-fxtec-pro1.dts since v5.16 (AngeloGioacchino Del Regno, 2021), no audio codec nodes in msm8998.dtsi. gitlab.com/msm8998-mainline/linux (last commit 2023-02-05, 6.1) adds panel boe,bf060y8m-aj0 (driver upstream since v5.17), a GPU node with a voltage hack, the keyboard via AW9523 plus an out-of-tree gpio-fastmatrix-keyboard (pinctrl-aw9523 upstream since v6.9), haptics. pmaports MR !2984 (2022) closed unmerged; the postmarketOS msm8998 kernel package is stuck at 6.0. Mesa freedreno a5xx gives GLES 3.1. Display, GPU, keyboard and audio would need upstreaming first.

related_devices.title: F(x)tec Pro1-X hybris port (contrast and baseline)
related_devices.general: works as a hybris port: the same phone on the vendor 4.19 kernel with Halium, used as the performance baseline and as a source of adaptation values.
related_devices.instance: piggz's halium-qx1050 (sailfish-on-fxtecpro1), newest image SFOS 5.0.0.62 (2025-04-09), upgradable to 5.1 through OBS nemo:testing:hw:fxtec:halium-qx1050:5.1; Halium 4.19 rework pushed 2026-10-03/04. Needs the stock F(x)tec v2.1.2 base on the phone; DNS on 5.1 needs systemd-resolve in group inet (PARANOID_NETWORK).
